note: practiced.py reads: episodes (the session's allowance), open (at a time), config (the cell's run settings: limits = tests/grader_config.json limits with time_limit_s = tests/hidden/limits.json's value; pose_source, render_backend, msaa_rgb = grader_config.json's), sites[] (package relative to this file's folder, sha256 checked at every reset, kind 'cal' -> the calibration debrief, 'practice' -> the practice debrief; time_limit_s overrides the limit for that site). No noise_seed: every practice episode draws its own set-down error and sensor noise. The per-point report budget comes from voidscore/acceptance.yaml.
